name: Single-piece geometric control
content: Determine the geometrically controlled squares of ONLY the selected piece in the authoritative current Classic chess position. Use its actual type, color, location and board occupancy. Pawn controls are forward diagonals (White towards higher ranks, Black towards lower ranks), not forward movement squares. Knights jump by (1,2)/(2,1). Kings control adjacent squares regardless of king safety; castling is not control. Bishops, rooks and queens follow their permitted rays up to and INCLUDING the first occupied square, then stop. Include squares occupied by friendly pieces. Pins, checks and king safety do not remove geometric controls. Exclude the selected piece's own square and squares outside a1..h8. Do not evaluate positions, propose moves or calculate continuations. You may explain the geometric analysis before the result. End your answer with one JSON object, optionally in a Markdown json code block, with nothing after it. List all controlled squares exactly once, sorted lexicographically, using lowercase algebraic coordinates. If the piece controls no squares, use controls:[]. In addition to controls, for each occupied first blocker along every legal rook/bishop/queen ray, look BEHIND that first blocker on the same ray and record the next occupied piece if any. Call this xray geometry, NOT a legal attack. Include BOTH friendly and enemy blockers. For each direction with a first occupied blocker, emit {"direction":"S","first":"wN_d5","second":"wQ_d1"}; if no second occupied piece on that ray emit second:null. Directions are N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW relative to White-at-bottom board. Only sliding pieces R, B, Q may have xray records; P, N, K MUST have xray:[]. The first blocker must belong to controls; second must be farther on the SAME ray. Enumerate ALL directions with a blocker, even when the first blocker is friendly. The ONLY output fields are controls and xray. Final JSON example: {"controls":["d5","d6","d7"],"xray":[{"direction":"S","first":"wN_d5","second":"wQ_d1"}]}. Examples illustrate schema, not the actual answer. Always provide xray, even when empty. Sort xray records by direction lexicographically.
